name: Arx Fatalis
notes: On Linux, the Arx Libertatis engine reimplementation (arx-libertatis.org) is a strong alternative: it runs natively without Wine or Proton, reuses your existing Arx Fatalis data files, and reproduces the game's environmental reverb through OpenAL Soft's EFX out of the box. It's self-contained, so use it or this script's approach, not both.
